name: XDKNet 2.5.8
body:
Android TV 2.5.8. No server plugin update this time: it works with plugin
2.1.0.7 (Emby 2.0.5.7).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Back where you were after turning the TV off

Turning the TV off during an episode or film and coming back to the app
started it again from the beginning, with a "Skip Recap" or "Skip Intro"
prompt on screen, while backing out and pressing Play again resumed in the
right place.

- The app now picks up at the spot you were at when the TV went off.
- Skip prompts and Next up wait until the video is open at its resume point,
  so they no longer appear for a moment at the start of a resume.

Use with plugin 2.1.0.7 (Emby 2.0.5.7).
